title: The Crossroads of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji set foot in the mortal realm, a token covered in Heavenly Dao runes slipped silently from the messenger's sleeve—not the seal of a mortal dynasty, but a summons from the very source of the Heavenly Dao.

text.content: As the seven rays of light receded like an ebb tide, the Tianji Record floated before Chen Ji, each page radiating a warm jade-like luster. He stared at the signature on the seventh page—Chen Xuan—the delicate strokes achingly familiar, identical to the handwriting in the testament letter his mother had left him. His heart seized painfully, an inexplicable emotion churning in his chest. Was it shock, confusion, or some hidden anticipation? Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the fragment: "You finally see it." Chen Ji drew a sharp breath, forcing himself to remain calm. Memories surged like a tide—orphaned in childhood, bullied in his youth, the humiliating years as a servant in the Tianqing Sect... So it was all predestined, long before his very birth.

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng, who was my mother? Why was she connected to the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's voice was steady, yet concealed an unmistakable urgency. A sigh echoed from the fragment: "Chen Xiansheng was the first master of the Tianji Record, three hundred years before you. She peered into the ultimate secrets of the Heavenly Dao, and thus drew the gaze of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. Her death... was no accident." Chen Ji's fists clenched sharply, knuckles whitening. Three hundred years ago? Wasn't she his mother? How could she have existed three hundred years ago? Countless questions churned in his mind.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense his confusion, continuing: "The host of the Tianji Record is not flesh and blood, but soul as fuel and Heavenly Fate as fire, passed down through generations. The blood of Chen Xuan flows in you—that is fact; but Chen Xuan herself perished in that catastrophe three hundred years ago. She merged her lifetime of knowledge with the Tianji Record, solely to await an heir capable of breaking the shackles." Chen Ji remained silent for a long while, then suddenly laughed. That smile carried traces of mockery, of release. So his fate had been arranged from the very beginning, his mother paving the way with her life, and he was merely the newest piece on this chessboard.

Just then, the seventh page of the Tianji Record erupted in dazzling golden light. Chen Ji's vision blurred as three distinct visions flashed before him like a revolving lantern. In the first, he broke free from all shackles, the Heavenly Dao crumbled, and he stood proud atop the ruins, Chen Nian flying freely by his side. In the second, he sat upon the Heavenly Dao's throne, all beings bowing in worship, yet Chen Nian was sealed by his own hands. In the third, the Heavenly Dao perished with him, the universe returned to primordial chaos, and Chen Nian stood tearfully in the void. Three paths, three fates, presented before him with such clarity for the first time.

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, fixing his eyes upon the three phantom images. The first path: break the shackles and gain freedom, at the cost of unknown consequences after the Heavenly Dao's collapse. The second path: replace it and become the new chess player, yet bearing the risk of turning his closest kin into enemies. The third path: perish together with the Heavenly Dao, trading his life for a sliver of hope for Chen Nian and all beings. Every path bristled with thorns, every path demanded unimaginable sacrifice. The Tianji Record's radiance swirled behind him, as if awaiting his decision. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more: "I shall unseal these three paths for you in sequence. But before that, you must make the first crucial choice—stabilize the mortal realm, or strike directly at the Heavenly Realm?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji, you are about to embark on the final campaign. Before the decisive battle in the Heavenly Realm, you must first consolidate your mortal foundations. Your first move will determine the subsequent trajectory.

choices.text: First resolve the hidden dangers in the mortal realm
choices.description: The mortal dynasty has colluded with foreign enemies; if internal strife and external threats are not properly handled, even victory in the Heavenly Realm will lead to chaos back home. Chen Nian's whereabouts also need to be traced in the mortal realm.
choices.visible_cost: Delaying the Heavenly Realm battle may give the Eyes of Heavenly Dao more preparation time
choices.visible_reward: Consolidating the rear and eliminating hidden dangers allows you to focus entirely on confronting the Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: You may become entangled in mortal realm power struggles, missing the optimal window for battle

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, a serene curve forming at the corner of his mouth: "For a chess game to function, the board must first be stable. Until the hidden dangers of the mortal realm are eliminated, I cannot rest easy facing the Heavenly Dao." His tone was calm, yet carried undeniable confidence.

choices.text: Strike directly at the Heavenly Realm and behead the Heavenly Dao
choices.description: Speed is paramount in warfare; the Eyes of Heavenly Dao are gathering strength, and every moment of delay increases the variables. The mortal matters are merely minor ailments; the true threat always lies in the Heavenly Realm.
choices.visible_cost: Mortal realm hidden dangers may erupt趁机, unstable rear may lead to being attacked from both sides
choices.visible_reward: Permanently solve the root of the Heavenly Dao, eliminate the roots and leave no future trouble
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao are amassing power; a hasty attack may lead to total defeat

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, a sharp glint flashing in his eyes: "The supreme path is simple—eradicate the roots. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao are the source of all evil; once slain, those mortal realm clowns will scatter like startled birds." His voice was cold as frost, his words carrying undeniable killing intent.

choices.text: Divide forces and proceed simultaneously on both fronts
choices.description: Deploy in both the mortal realm and Heavenly Realm simultaneously, using a two-pronged approach. Though risky, success would grant absolute advantage. Chen Ji's wisdom is sufficient to sustain this bold gamble.
choices.visible_cost: Divided forces may neglect one side while attending to the other, with doubled consumption
choices.visible_reward: Once successful, it creates absolute advantage, with victory already secured
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high demands on strategy and resources; any issue on either front could lead to total defeat

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lightly tapped the pages of the Tianji Record, his gaze deep: "The mortal realm and the Heavenly Realm are merely two pieces on a grand chessboard. I will make them move simultaneously, leaving the Heavenly Eye unable to attend to both ends." His smile carried a hint of madness, yet within that madness showed absolute rationality.

text.content: Having made his choice, Chen Ji did not rush into action. He slowly closed his eyes, the Tianji Record floating before him as countless images began flowing through his mind. The Servants' Quarters of the Tianqing Sect, the ancient tomb secret realm of Shaolin Temple, the depths of the Forbidden Grounds of the Demonic Path Holy Sect... scenes of the past flickered like a lantern carousel. His transformation from atrash disciple to a Chess Player had taken a full ten years. During those ten years, he had无数次徘徊在生死边缘，无数次被人踩在脚下，却始终endured不发，scheme in secret。如今，the Tianji Record was finally complete, its twelve pages containing power enough to shake heaven and earth. But he knew—the closer he got to the truth, the more dangerous it became. The Heavenly Eye had never stopped watching him, that invisible pressure following him like a shadow.

dialogue.content: "What are you thinking?" Mo Xiansheng's voice broke his contemplation. Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze falling on Chen Xuan's signature on the seventh page of the Tianji Record: "I'm thinking about Mother. She spent three hundred years laying out this game, just to place me where I stand today. What did she see that made her willing to make such a sacrifice?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before saying: "She saw you. She saw that you would become the only person capable of breaking the Heavenly Dao's shackles." Chen Ji forced a bitter smile: "So she bet everything on me? Even going so far as to sacrifice her own life?" Mo Xiansheng gave no answer, but that silence itself was an answer.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, pushing down those chaotic thoughts. Right now, he had no time for sentimentality. His mother had paved the way for three hundred years, and he could not let her down. His gaze sharpened again as Chen Ji began deducing the chess game ahead. The mortal empire colluding with foreign enemies, intending to profit from the chaos in the Heavenly Realm; the three great sects each harboring ulterior motives, ready to turn against each other at any moment; the Demonic Path Holy Sect, though temporarily allied, remained a hidden threat. If these problems were not solved, even if he defeated the Heavenly Eye, the mortal realm would fall into endless chaos. More importantly—Chen Nian was still waiting for him somewhere. 天命锁钥, that was the close relative he must find.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record fluttered softly as Chen Ji's gaze fell upon a certain page. It was a blurry vision, Chen Nian's figure flickering within, bound by countless chains in a dark space. Her lips moved, seemingly speaking, yet no sound could be heard. Chen Ji's heart clenched tightly. Three years—he had been searching for Chen Nian for three full years. From her original innocence and brightness, to the terror and despair when the Holy Sect took her away, to now... Chen Nian, where are you? The Tianji Record's foresight was always blurred when it came to her—what did this mean? Was it because she was the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, or was someone deliberately blocking heavenly secrets? Either answer made him shudder with cold fear.

text.content: Gathering his thoughts, Chen Ji began laying out his strategy. He waved his hand, and several rays of light flew from his fingertips, transforming into several message jade talismans that vanished into the void. First was the message to Ye Qing—the situation in the Demonic Path Holy Sect was delicate. Though Ye Qing was the Saintess, she had always been constrained by the Holy Sect's senior members. Their cooperation was built on mutual benefit, and now Chen Ji needed to go further. The jade talisman pierced through layers of void, reaching directly into the depths of the Demonic Path Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. After a moment, a seductive yet dangerous divine sense transmitted back: "Chen Ji? You've finally decided to contact me." Chen Ji's lips curved slightly: "Ye Qing, our next meeting will either be an alliance or a decisive battle."

dialogue.content: Deep within the Demonic Path Holy Sect, Ye Qing received this message. Her enchanting face briefly displayed a complex expression. She set down her teacup, a playful smile curling her lips: "Interesting. Thetrash disciple finally reveals his fangs?" She rose, demonic mist swirling around her, completely isolating all prying eyes. The attendant beside her carefully asked: "Saintess, how should we respond?" Ye Qing narrowed her eyes, her smile hiding a dangerous light: "Tell him, this Saintess will be waiting for him in the mortal realm. However—the next meeting won't unfold as he wishes." Her tone was both intimate and dangerous, clearly showing great interest in this mysterious partner.

text.content: Having handled the contact with Ye Qing, Chen Ji began preparing his descent to the mortal realm. The Tianji Record slowly unfolded behind him, twelve pages merging into one, radiating brilliant light. That radiance was vast as the Milky Way, solemn as heavenly might, yet carrying a trace of tenderness—the lingering aura of his mother Chen Xuan. Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped forward. The void trembled, light enveloping his form like a falling star, hurtling toward the mortal realm. Clouds surged beneath his feet, wind howled past his ears, and he closed his eyes, allowing the Tianji Record's power to guide him. The mortal realm—I have returned. Imperial envoys, foreign invaders, the three great sects—those跳梁小丑 should finally understand what a true Chess Player means.

choice.prompt: The method of descending to the mortal realm will determine the direction of the upcoming situation. Which posture do you choose to appear before the world?

choices.text: Announce the descent with auspicious clouds
choices.description: Declare to the world in the most shocking way that the complete Tianji Record holder has descended to the mortal realm. Directly intimidate the petty characters, saving much unnecessary probing and trouble.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing strength too early will make all forces increase their vigilance, and enemies will prepare in advance
choices.visible_reward: Reputation will greatly increase, intimidating petty characters, possibly attracting potential allies to seek allegiance proactively
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may locate your position through this action

text.content: The sky suddenly tore open with a massive crack, golden rosy clouds pouring from the fissure, dyeing the entire world into a brilliant scene. Chen Ji descended on auspicious clouds, the Tianji Record behind him radiating万丈光辉, illuminating half the sky. Countless mortal cultivators lifted their heads, gaping at that divinely miraculous figure. trash disciple? Those people at this moment only felt utterly ridiculous about themselves.

choices.text: Descend covertly by hiding one's aura
choices.description: Appear in the mortal realm silently without alerting anyone. Observe the situation secretly, ascertain the enemy's底牌 before striking.
choices.visible_cost: Will require more time to arrange, possibly missing some opportunities
choices.visible_reward: Achieve surprise and attack when the enemy is unprepared, delivering a deadly blow when they are completely off-guard
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by the enemy, will be viewed as cowardice

text.content: The void slightly rippled, Chen Ji's figure appearing like a wisp of smoke in a remote mountain forest of the mortal realm. He收敛了全部气息, appearing to outsiders as merely an ordinary young cultivator, with nothing noteworthy. The Tianji Record's light was also suppressed to its minimum, completely undetectable to others. A slight smile curved his lips: "Time to show these跳梁小丑 what a true Chess Player really is."

choices.text: Appear in identity of Tianqing Sect disciple
choices.description: Disguise as an ordinary disciple returning to the sect, secretly investigating internal hidden dangers. Not everyone within the sect is necessarily united; someone must quietly eliminate hidden threats.
choices.visible_cost: Will need to act, possibly being provoked by some disrespectful individuals
choices.visible_reward: Can secretly eliminate traitors, uncover hidden enemies
choices.risk_hint: If his identity is exposed, he may fall into the maelstrom of sect infighting.

text.content: Chen Ji changed into the attire of a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple, suppressed his cultivation to the Qi Refining stage, and quietly appeared outside the Sect Gate. He lowered his head, hunched his back, looking completely like a wretch crushed by life. The gate guard disciple cast a sidelong glance at him: "Oh, isn't this thetrash Chen Ji? Weren't you missing for several years? What, can't make a living anymore?" Chen Ji nodded obsequiously: "Yes, yes, senior brother is right, I just want to come back to continue serving as a menial servant..." His subservient appearance revealed no flaws, yet in those deep eyes, a cold gleam flickered.

Chen Ji's chosen low-profile infiltration route led him quietly to a hidden valley somewhere in the mortal realm. Though still a thousand li from the Imperial City, he could sense the Dynasty's movements through a special formation. Just as he prepared to investigate further, the Tianji Record suddenly trembled slightly. A message pierced through the Void - an urgent report from his mortal informant: "Reporting to Master, the Dynasty envoy has arrived outside Tianqing Sect! He claims to represent the Heavenly Origin and wishes to discuss cooperation with Tianqing Sect!" Chen Ji's eyes turned sharp instantly. The Dynasty envoy representing the Heavenly Origin? What did this mean? Has the Eye of Heavenly Dao extended its reach into the mortal Dynasty? Or... is there an even higher existence manipulating everything behind the scenes?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record rapidly operating within his mind, countless images beginning to emerge. The true identity of the Dynasty envoy, the true face of the Heavenly Origin, the conspiracy hidden behind this so-called "cooperation"... However, just as he tried to glimpse, a powerful force suddenly backlash. It was a cold and majestic consciousness, like the heavens gazing down at ants. Chen Ji shuddered violently, cold sweat appeared on his forehead. The Eye of Heavenly Dao! It actually intervened directly to disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight! And within that force seemed to be mixed with some even higher-level aura, far more ancient and terrifying than the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: "Chen Ji, don't look anymore! That is an existence beyond Heavenly Dao, your current strength is insufficient to glimpse!"

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, gasping for air. Though that glimpse was forcibly interrupted, it let him see a blurry image - hidden in the Dynasty envoy's sleeve was a token, covered with dense and countless runes, those runes did not belong to any known cultivation system, but came from an even higher dimension. At the center of the runes,赫然 were four characters: Heavenly Origin. That was not the mark of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but a true existence beyond Heavenly Dao! Chen Ji's heart sank. The Eye of Heavenly Dao was terrifying enough, and now this Heavenly Origin appeared? Could there be something even higher above Heavenly Dao? What did his mother Chen Xuan discover three hundred years ago that brought about her death?

The wind howled through the valley, Chen Ji stood atop a massive boulder, gazing at the distant horizon. The setting sun stretched his shadow long, solitary on the ground. The Tianji Record floated beside him, emitting a warm radiance. He suddenly remembered many things - his mother's teachings in childhood, the humiliations and forbearance of youth, every life-and-death choice after embarking on the cultivation path. Fromtrash disciple to Chess Player, he had traveled very far. And now, he was about to go even further, even if ahead lay the abyss of existence beyond Heavenly Dao. "Chen Nian..." he murmured softly, "Wait for me, I will find you." Behind him, the Tianji Record's light grew increasingly brilliant, as if responding to his determination. In the distance, the Dynasty's banners fluttered loudly in the wind, a storm that could shake the three realms was about to arrive.

Just then, a earth-shaking pressure suddenly came from the sky. A golden light tore across the void, flying directly toward Tianqing Sect. Within that golden light could be vaguely seen a figure in Dynasty official robes, with overwhelming momentum, wherever it passed the wind and clouds changed color. Chen Ji squinted, gazing at that golden light, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth. Heavenly Origin? Interesting. But since you're here, let this one see what nerve you have to put on acts of god before me. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, the Tianji Record gently fluttering behind him, pages of text sparkling like stars. The chess game was set, just waiting to see how the opponent would make their move. Dynasty envoy, friend or foe - an answer will come soon.

Night gradually fell, Chen Ji收敛 all aura, silently glided toward Tianqing Sect. He needed to see personally what kind of background this Dynasty envoy had, while also gauging the sect's internal stance. Ling Yuan the old Sect Master, Su Qingyao... what roles did these people play in this chess game? The Tianji Record in his arms warmed slightly, seemingly also looking forward to the impending confrontation. Moonlight like water, sprinkling on his body, making his shadow long and lonely. He was already prepared, whether ahead was friend or foe, deity or demon, he would walk step by step until the end of destiny. In the distance, Tianqing Sect's mountain gate loomed vaguely in the moonlight, a storm sufficient to change the three-realm structure was brewing within.
